summary: Security analysis completed with 1 high, 1 medium, 1 low severity findings discovered across 4 total findings.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe XML Parsing
 * @description Parsing XML with standard libraries without defusing can lead to XXE.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-xml-parsing
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("xml.etree.ElementTree").getMember("parse").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml.etree.ElementTree").getMember("fromstring").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml.sax").getMember("parse").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml.sax").getMember("parseString").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml.dom.minidom").getMember("parse").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml.dom.minidom").getMember("parseString").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml.etree").getMember("parse").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml.etree").getMember("fromstring").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential unsafe XML parsing."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe XML parsing using standard libraries which might be vulnerable to XXE.

select call, "Potential command execution sink"

/**
 * @name Code Injection via eval/exec

 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity high

 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 *       external/cwe/cwe-095
 */

import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
